# Brivya

> Business-to-Agent infrastructure · v0.1.0-alpha.1

This website documents the open Brivya framework. It is not a callable production Business Agent. No business execution, OAuth or tool endpoint is advertised here. APIs are pre-stable. Discovery does not grant authorization.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://brivya.com/en/docs/index.md): Build a Business Agent, from its first contract to governed execution and platform integration.
- [Quick Start](https://brivya.com/en/docs/quickstart/index.md): Create your first business contract and validate the local development configuration.
- [Architecture and safety](https://brivya.com/en/docs/architecture/index.md): One business truth, many projections. Every mutation follows the same governed execution path.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://brivya.com/en/docs/sdk/index.md): Reuse public business types, Manifest validation and the canonical runtime.
- [Protocols and platforms](https://brivya.com/en/docs/adapters/index.md): REST and MCP share the runtime. Distribution profiles reuse canonical business semantics.
- [Extension Host](https://brivya.com/en/docs/extensions/index.md): Declare permissions explicitly and extend capabilities through a scoped Host API.
- [Restaurant reference](https://brivya.com/en/docs/restaurant/index.md): Follow discovery, reservations, orders and payment requests through deterministic contract tests.
- [Versions and packages](https://brivya.com/en/docs/releases/index.md): Understand the public Alpha modules, installation and stability boundaries.
- [Contributing and security](https://brivya.com/en/docs/contributing/index.md): Help improve business contracts, developer tools and platform conformance.
